name: Stoichiometry, Thermodynamic Flux Cone, C'-Dot Biophysics & Literature Audit

findings.title: Unconstrained linear nullspace projection v = r @ P_null violates v_r >= 0 on ~50% of irreversible reactions
C' dot biophysics multiplies by fe_load (predicting 0 iron flux if fe_load=0 for iron-free silica C' dots!) and hardcodes TFRC instead of MC1R/PSMA

details.biological_truth: Cornell prime dots (C' dots; Kim et al., Nat. Nanotechnol. 2016) are synthesized WITHOUT iron cores; their surface PEG/silanol groups adsorb/chelate ambient ferric iron (Fe3+) from media/TME and traffic it into endolysosomes under amino-acid starvation (alpha-MSH/MC1R in melanoma; PSMAi/FOLH1 in prostate).

findings.title: MBOAT1/2 (Liang et al., Cell 2023), SC5D, and VKORC1L1 are in 64 cis-loci but omitted from 28 protein anchors; k_dhodh_clear lacks DHODH enzyme scaling

details.dhodh_note: diff_ferro_gem.py line 388 computes k_dhodh_clear = k_dhodh_c * (1 - 0.90*occ_dhodh) without multiplying by DHODH expression, and Mishima et al. (Nature 2023) showed high-dose Brequinar ferroptosis sensitization partly acts via FSP1 inhibition.

findings.title: Peer-reviewed reference & retraction verification across foundational C' dot, 7-DHC, FSP1-VK, MBOAT1/2 & wave papers
